title: 雨音のアップデートと、ボクらの星図デバッグ
author: ネオ・カナタ

en.title: Rain Sound Update and Our Star Chart Debugging
en.premise: Only on rainy days does a mysterious cafe appear on your phone’s map app. Inside, you meet a girl clutching an old star chart, searching for the world’s hidden bugs. Every time the rain stops, her presence vanishes like a log, and you can only connect with her through SNS. As the boundary between digital and real glitches, we must debug our own place in this strange world.

zh.title: 雨声的更新与我们的星图调试
zh.premise: 只有在雨天，那家神秘的咖啡店才会出现在手机地图应用上。你在那里遇见一位手握古老星图、寻找“世界漏洞”的少女。每当雨停，她的存在就像日志一样消失，只能通过社交媒体与她相连。随着数字与现实的边界开始崩溃，我们必须调试自己的位置，寻找归属感。
